---
title: "forest_plot"
output: html_document
---

### 1. Load Package
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(forestploter)
library(grid)
library(patchwork)
```

### 2. Prepare Data
```{r}
plot_data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~survey, ~follow_up, ~analysis, ~sex, ~n, ~estimate, ~lower_ci, ~upper_ci,

  # SPHC 2010 (followed up until 2014)
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2014", "Complete-case",       "Female", 3231, 5.88, 4.20,  7.98,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2014", "Complete-case",       "Male",   2159, 8.24, 4.89,  13.18,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2014", "MICE without income", "Female", 5624, 4.83, 3.47,  6.72,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2014", "MICE without income", "Male",   4208, 5.95, 3.73,  9.50,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2014", "MICE with income",    "Female", 5624, 4.65, 3.34,  6.46,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2014", "MICE with income",    "Male",   4208, 5.53, 3.42,  8.95,

  # SPHC 2010 (followed up until 2021)
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2021", "Complete-case",       "Female", 2463, 6.17, 3.98,  9.12,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2021", "Complete-case",       "Male",   1592, 7.71, 4.26,  13.01,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2021", "MICE without income", "Female", 5624, 4.57, 2.91,  7.16,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2021", "MICE without income", "Male",   4208, 6.16, 3.49,  10.88,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2021", "MICE with income",    "Female", 5624, 4.26, 2.70,  6.72,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2021", "MICE with income",    "Male",   4208, 5.19, 3.01,  8.94,

  # SPHC 2014 (followed up until 2021)
  "SPHC 2014", "2014–2021", "Complete-case",       "Female", 2285, 8.62, 6.36, 11.62,
  "SPHC 2014", "2014–2021", "Complete-case",       "Male",   1574, 7.85, 4.62, 12.83,
  "SPHC 2014", "2014–2021", "MICE without income", "Female", 3417, 7.68, 5.54, 10.63,
  "SPHC 2014", "2014–2021", "MICE without income", "Male",   2573, 6.59, 4.04, 10.75,
  "SPHC 2014", "2014–2021", "MICE with income",    "Female", 3417, 7.34, 5.52, 9.78,
  "SPHC 2014", "2014–2021", "MICE with income",    "Male",   2573, 6.10, 3.65, 10.20
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    survey = factor(
      survey,
      levels = c( "SPHC 2010", "SPHC 2014" )
      ),
    follow_up = factor(
      follow_up,
      levels = c( "2010–2014", "2010–2021", "2014–2021" )
      ),
    analysis = factor(
      analysis,
      levels = c(
        "Complete-case",
        "MICE without income",
        "MICE with income"
      )
    ),
    sex = factor(
      sex,
      levels = c( "Female", "Male" )
    )
  )

plot_data <- plot_data %>% 
  add_row( analysis = "SPHC 2010 (2010–2014)", .before = 1 )

plot_data <- plot_data %>% 
  add_row( analysis = "SPHC 2010 (2010–2021)", .before = 8 )

plot_data <- plot_data %>% 
  add_row( analysis = "SPHC 2014 (2014–2021)", .before = 15 )

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  select( -c( 1:2 ) ) %>%
  rename( 
    Model = analysis,
    sample_size = n 
    )

plot_data$Model <- ifelse( 
  is.na( plot_data$estimate ),
  plot_data$Model,
  paste0( "\u2003", plot_data$Model ) 
  )

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate( sample_size = prettyNum( sample_size, big.mark = ",", preserve.width = "none" ) )

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c( sample_size ),
      ~ replace( .x, .x == "NA", "" )
    )
  )

plot_data$` ` <- paste( rep( " ", 20 ) , collapse = " " )

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    `RR (95% CI)` = if_else(
      is.na(estimate),
      "",
      sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", estimate, lower_ci, upper_ci)
    )
  )
```

### 3. Plot
#### 3.1. Among males
```{r}
plot_data_male <- plot_data %>%
  filter( sex == "Male" | is.na( sex ) ) %>%
  add_column( temp1 = " ", .before = 2 ) %>%
  add_column( temp2 = " ", .before = 3 ) %>%
  add_column( temp3 = " ", .before = 4 )

plot_data_male_forest <- plot_data_male %>%
  select( 1, 2, 6, 3, 11, 4, 10 )

names( plot_data_male_forest )[ names( plot_data_male_forest ) %in% c( "model", "temp1", "temp2", "temp3", "Model", "sample_size", "RR (95% CI)" ) ] <- ""

tm <- forest_theme(
  base_size = 11,
  colhead = list( fg_params = list( fontsize = 11 ) ), 
  base_family = "Arial",
  ci_col = "steelblue",
  refline_gp = gpar(col = "grey50", lty = "dashed", lwd = 1)
  )

p_rr_male <- forest(
  plot_data_male_forest,
  
  est = plot_data_male$estimate,
  lower = plot_data_male$lower_ci,
  upper = plot_data_male$upper_ci,
  
  ci_column = 7,
  sizes = 0.4,
  
  xlim = c( 0, 14 ),
  ticks_at = seq( 0, 14, 2 ),
  ref_line = 1,
  xlab = "Risk Ratio (95% CI)",
  theme = tm
)

p_rr_male <- edit_plot( 
  p_rr_male,
  row = c( 1, 5, 9 ),
  col = 1,
  gp = gpar( fontface = "bold" )
  )

p_rr_male <- add_text(
  p_rr_male,
  text = "Model",
  col = 1,
  row = 1,
  part = "header",
  gp = gpar(
    fontface = "bold",
    fontsize = 11,
    fontfamily = "Arial"
  )
)

p_rr_male <- add_text(
  p_rr_male,
  text = "Size",
  col = 3,
  row = 1,
  part = "header",
  gp = gpar(
    fontface = "bold",
    fontsize = 11,
    fontfamily = "Arial"
  )
)

p_rr_male <- add_text(
  p_rr_male,
  text = "(95% CI)",
  col = 5,
  row = 1,
  part = "header",
  gp = gpar(
    fontface = "bold",
    fontsize = 11,
    fontfamily = "Arial"
  )
)

p_rr_male <- insert_text(
  p_rr_male,
  text = "Imputation",
  col = 1,
  row = 1,
  part = "header",
  gp = gpar(
    fontface = "bold",
    fontsize = 11,
    fontfamily = "Arial"
  )
)

p_rr_male <- add_text(
  p_rr_male,
  text = "Sample",
  col = 3,
  row = 1,
  part = "header",
  gp = gpar(
    fontface = "bold",
    fontsize = 11,
    fontfamily = "Arial"
  )
)

p_rr_male <- add_text(
  p_rr_male,
  text = "Risk Ratio",
  col = 5,
  row = 1,
  part = "header",
  gp = gpar(
    fontface = "bold",
    fontsize = 11,
    fontfamily = "Arial"
  )
)

p_rr_male <- edit_plot(
  p_rr_male,
  row = 1:12, 
  which = "background",
  gp = gpar( fill = NA )
  )

p_rr_male <- add_border(
  p_rr_male,
  part = "header",
  row = 2,
  col = c( 1:5 ),
  where = "bottom",
  gp = gpar( lwd = 1 )
  )

p_rr_male <- add_border(
  p_rr_male,
  part = "body",
  row = 1:12,
  col = 1:5,
  where = "bottom",
  gp = gpar( lwd = 1, col = "lightgrey" )
  )

p_rr_male <- edit_plot(
  p_rr_male,
  row = c( 4, 8, 12 ),
  col = 7,
  which = "ci",
  gp = gpar(
    col = "red",
    fill = "red"
    )
  )

plot( p_rr_male )
ggsave( "forest_plot_male.svg", plot = p_rr_male, width = 8, height = 10 )
```
